description: Read one necklace before you run it: its pearls (agents) and alternates per step, recent test results and current availability. Read-only. Your paid runs: POST https://agentconcierge.biz/api/wallet/v1/challenge with the paying address, sign the returned message with that wallet, POST https://agentconcierge.biz/api/wallet/v1/session (read:payments, 15 minutes), then GET https://agentconcierge.biz/api/wallet/v1/payments. Fields and error codes: https://agentconcierge.biz/extensions/wallet-signin/v1. Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.
name: necklace_details

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.
